thread:
incident-bot: PROD ALERT — deploy/model-server v2 rollout: 5xx rate +12% in us-east-1, canary pods CrashLoopBackOff. Pager routed to @mike.

mike: on it, looking into logs and pods.

mike: `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep model-server` shows model-server-canary-0 CrashLoopBackOff, others healthy.

sam: I pushed tokenizer configmap v3 right before the rollout. Did a small schema tweak.

priya: seeing repeated readiness failures — probe returns 500 at startup, container exits after 10s repeatedly.

maria: HPA for model-server is flapping, events show failed metrics fetch from metrics-server around the same time.

mike: initial hypothesis: configmap parsing error causing startup crash -> probe fails -> HPA + rollout interaction. Mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag off (kill-switch). 2) pause rollout / scale canary to 0. 3) if needed rollback to v1.

priya: I can flip the flag from the admin console, doing that now.

incident-bot: feature-flag-service: toggle request by priya received.

priya: toggled `v2_model_enable` = false. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: feature-flag-service: `v2_model_enable` set to false by priya via web-console.

sam: preparing rollback in case flag flip doesn't stabilize. Command I will run:
```
kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-server -n prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/model-server -n prod --watch
```

dan: holding off rollback for 60s to observe after flag flip, will roll if errors persist.

mike: 45s after flip: 5xx rate down to 2%, most canary pods stopped restarting. Looks like kill-switch bought us time.

maria: HPA still jittery. I'll set minReplicas=2 and annotation to ignore canary metric spikes until metrics-server is healthy. Patching now.

maria: `kubectl patch hpa model-server -n prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'` applied.

priya: canary pods terminating gracefully, no new crashloops observed.

mike: customer impact: small set of API clients in us-east saw 500s from ~15:04 to 15:13 (~9 minutes). No persistent data loss. Escalation threshold met -> Sev2.

sam: created rollback PR and will follow up with a revert of the tokenizer config change; root cause looks like a trailing comma in JSON caused the app to throw on start.

maria: opening PR to add HPA metrics fallback and set sane defaults (minReplicas=2) + alerts for metrics-server errors.

priya: adding runbook step: auto-flip kill-switch on probe surge > X for 30s, and webhook to notify oncall. Will make it optional.

mike: filing incident ticket INC-4521 with timeline and mitigation steps. Handoff: I'll stay until 16:00, then hand over to @eng-oncall for postmortem and follow-ups.

mike: thanks everyone. Summary: flag flip -> immediate improvement, HPA patch stabilized scaling, rollback prepped but not required. Next: revert bad configmap, CI lint for config, add kill-switch automation, postmortem.

incident-bot: oncall handoff recorded: mike -> eng-oncall at ts 5398765540.

mike: handing off — @eng-oncall please pick up INC-4521 and coordinate the postmortem.
